definitions.explanation: Beans that have not been cooked, roasted, or otherwise processed. Used when distinguishing raw beans from their prepared forms.

definitions.gloss: green coffee beans; unroasted coffee beans
definitions.explanation: Coffee beans in their raw, unroasted state. A term commonly used in the specialty coffee world, where enthusiasts purchase green beans and roast them at home.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (raw, unprocessed) and ⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧ (beans). The word has two distinct usage domains: general cooking (raw beans of any kind) and specialty coffee (unroasted coffee beans).

In the coffee context, {生豆|なままめ} refers to the green, unroasted beans that are the starting material for roasting. The specialty coffee boom in Japan has made this sense increasingly common. Coffee enthusiasts and roasters use the term frequently when discussing bean origins, processing methods, and quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生豆|なままめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}する→焙煎する：25504_baisensuru⟧: to roast green coffee beans
- {生豆|なままめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧: origin of green beans
- {生豆|なままめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to select green beans
- {生豆|なままめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: condition of raw/green beans

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {煎|い}り⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧: roasted beans — beans that have been dry-roasted
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧: dried beans — beans preserved by drying, but not necessarily raw
- {焙煎豆|ばいせんまめ}: roasted coffee beans — the result after green beans are roasted
